invention: A method for training a deep neural network by adjusting weights via backpropagation so it learns to recognise objects in images.
A rechargeable lithium-ion secondary battery cell with improved electrode chemistry for electric vehicles.
An automotive driver-assistance system that estimates road conditions and controls vehicle speed and steering using lidar and radar sensors.
A cryptographic protocol for verifying the identity of a user during secure communication over a digital network using digital signatures.
A wearable device that measures a patient's physiological signals for diagnostic purposes and identifies the wearer.

A cryptographic communications system in which a message is encoded as a number M and enciphered by raising M to a predetermined power and computing the remainder when divided by the product of two predetermined prime numbers; the ciphertext is deciphered at the receiving terminal by raising it to a second predetermined power associated with the receiver and computing the residue modulo the same product of primes, recovering the original message.
source: Real patent: US 4,405,829 (RSA public-key cryptosystem, granted 1983, expired) — abstract, condensed; real CPC classifications include H04L 9/302 and H04L 9/30

A method of image analysis that segments object boundaries in a bitmap image and extracts their contours for measurement.
A mobile payment system that authorises contactless transactions between a phone wallet and a merchant terminal.
A new recipe for a gluten-free sourdough bread using a wild yeast starter and a slow overnight fermentation.
